title: Borrowed wrapper carrying a polymorphic Long
notes: Generated, not transcribed, by ./gradlew :wire:wireVectors -Pwire.vectors.write=true from `decoded`, then read back and pinned here. OBSERVED: the wrapper's polymorphic inner Long encodes as kotlin.Long and no default field is omitted. Decoding produces a fresh, unconsumed Borrowed wrapper; Borrowed has no equals, so the JVM driver compares it structurally through WireEquality (ncz.3-D6), while a non-JVM driver compares the inner value. Spec 23 says Owned crosses as move-by-serialize; the CONSUME is BridgeEgressCell.deliver's, pinned by OwnershipBoundaryTest, not by this vector. Leased has no vector because it never crosses (WV-NEG-LEASED-AT-ENCODE-01). covers [WIR1-C05] and [WIR1-I01]-[WIR1-I03].
